title: Dhoomakethu – Sajin Gopu, Nikhila Vimal, Shine Tom Chacko Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for Dhoomakethu – Sajin Gopu, Nikhila Vimal, Shine Tom Chacko — premieres Oct 23, 2026.
body:
• The trailer for Dhoomakethu – Sajin Gopu, Nikhila Vimal, Shine Tom Chacko dropped October 22, 2026.
  • New movie premiering Oct 23, 2026 on Netflix India.
  • A wedding day stuck on repeat, a death waiting to happen, and a mystery only Kuttan can solve

The makers of Dhoomakethu – Sajin Gopu, Nikhila Vimal, Shine Tom Chacko have released the official trailer, unveiled October 22, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
